integrity.verification: complete finite enumeration for total population at most 10

scientific_limitations: Exactly two named fixed-capacity teams and a complete bipartite unweighted symmetric friendship graph.
All agents have teammate-additive binary utilities; only individual exchanges between teams are considered.
The initiating paper was only partly available for technical full-text comparison, so an unindexed equivalent theorem remains possible.
title: Exact swap-stability hierarchy for two-team bipartite friendship games
